health.title: System health
health.description: Whether each part of Omniva is reachable. Refreshes every few seconds.

overall.degraded: Omniva works, more slowly: Redis is unreachable.
overall.down: Omniva is not working: a part it needs is down.

footer.tagline: A calm, private home for the important parts of your life.

home.title: Omniva: keep track of what matters

hero.heading: Keep track of what matters, and know what is coming
hero.body: Omniva keeps your documents, subscriptions, insurance, vehicles and more in one place, connects them, and reminds you before a date slips. You stay in control of your data.
hero.screenshotName: your records and what is coming

pillars.heading: Made for people who organize life by hand

connected.title: Everything connected
connected.body: The car knows its insurance. The washing machine knows its warranty. Ask what you are paying for, or what needs attention this month.

reminders.title: Told before it slips
reminders.body: Passports, renewals, free trials and warranties get a reminder ahead of the date, so nothing surprises you.

control.title: You stay in control
control.body: Nothing is shared unless you share it. Export everything, anytime. Deleting your data really deletes it.

cta.heading: Start with the one date that matters
cta.body: Add a car, a passport or a subscription and see what is coming in your first session.

features.title: Features
features.heading: Features
features.intro: Omniva stores information and, more importantly, connects it.

records.title: Records for everything
records.body: Keep cars, documents, subscriptions, insurance policies and household items as connected records.

keyDates.title: Key dates and reminders
keyDates.body: Each record carries the date that matters, such as an expiry, a renewal or the end of a warranty, with reminders before it.

links.title: Links between records
links.body: Connect a car to its policy and a repair to its invoice. Omniva also suggests connections you may have missed.

capture.title: Capture from anywhere
capture.body: Send a photo, a file or a forwarded email and turn it into a record when you are ready.

sharing.title: Share on your terms
sharing.body: Invite family or others to a workspace with the access you choose. Nothing is shared unless you share it.

export.title: Export, anytime
export.body: Take everything with you in an open format whenever you want.

features.screenshotName: your records and what is coming

how.title: How it works
how.heading: How it works
how.intro: From sign-up to knowing what is coming, in your first session.

one.title: Sign up
one.body: Create an account with your email address and a password, then verify your email.

two.title: Add what matters
two.body: Add a handful of real records: a car, a passport, subscriptions, insurance. Give each the one date that matters.

three.title: See what is coming
three.body: Your upcoming dates appear straight away, with reminders set for you.

four.title: Connect and grow
four.body: Link related records, capture new ones from email or photos, and let Omniva point out what needs attention.

pricing.title: Pricing
pricing.heading: Pricing
pricing.intro: Plans and prices have not been announced yet. Whatever they turn out to be, these promises hold.

items.read: You keep read-only access and export with no time limit, even if you stop paying.
items.ads: We never sell your data or show you ads.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.heading: Privacy
privacy.intro: Your records are personal. These are our commitments to you.

commitments.sell: We never sell your data or show you ads.
commitments.ai: We never use your data to train AI models.
commitments.delete: Deleting your data really deletes it.
commitments.share: Nothing is shared unless you share it.
commitments.readOnly: You keep read-only access and export with no time limit, even if you stop paying.

analytics.heading: On this website
analytics.body: This public website sets no cookies and uses no third-party trackers.

what.a: A personal life management platform that keeps your records connected and reminds you before important dates.

account.a: You can read these pages without one. Using the app needs an account, so that your data is always protected.

cost.a: Pricing has not been announced yet. You will always keep read-only access and export.

data.a: Only you, and the people you choose to share with. We never sell your data or use it to train AI models.

leave.q: Can I take my data with me?
leave.a: Yes. You can export everything, anytime.
